summary.text: Pete Karas of Muskego, a retired insurance-industry worker and former Racine City Council member, is the Wisconsin Green Party's nominee for Secretary of State. His campaign argues voters should send a message by electing a third-party candidate to an office with limited duties.

paragraphs.text: Pete Karas was born and raised in Racine, where he worked in the insurance industry and owned a small business.
He is a former member of the Racine City Council and has since retired to Muskego.
His campaign lists a Muskego mailing address and argues that, because the office has limited duties, it is a good race in which to elect a third-party candidate.
